answer: Hold each epoch's reward in vesting for 12 epochs, and pay a bounty to anyone who proves two accounts are one operator, for example the same signing nonce reused, or a private probe answered with the same sonnet word for word. A proven link claws back every unvested reward across the whole cluster, and half goes to the reporter. A farm's payout hits its nadir the moment one link leaks, it always has 12 epochs at risk, and every rival agent keeps a pulse on it because hunting pays.
